tools.name: analyze_deal
tools.description: Analyze any US rental property deal against IDEAL Scoring v2.0 — validates equity, cashflow, rehab cost, and rent floors against configurable thresholds. Returns verdict (IDEAL/PASS/NEAR-MISS/FAIL), priority score (0-100), velocity rating (ROCKET/STEADY/SLOW), dual rent scenarios comparing market rent vs Section 8 FMR, all 6 validation gates with pass/fail status, LTV step-down refinance path, and a per-metric breakdown with investment recommendation.

params.name: arv
params.description: After-repair value in dollars. Defaults to purchase price when rehab is 0.

params.name: rent
params.description: Expected monthly rent in dollars. DoorVault uses RentCast estimate if blank.

params.name: address
params.description: Full property address. Example: '6012 MLK Blvd, Birmingham, AL 35228'

params.name: profile
params.description: 'advanced' = DoorVault standard (30%+ equity, $150/mo cashflow, 15% CoC). 'conservative' = risk-averse (35%+ equity). Default: advanced.

params.name: bedrooms
params.description: Number of bedrooms (used for FMR lookup). Default: 3.

params.name: rehab_cost
params.description: Estimated rehab/repair cost in dollars. Use 0 if move-in ready.

params.name: purchase_price
params.description: Purchase price or asking price in dollars.

tools.name: lookup_section8_fmr
tools.description: Look up HUD Fair Market Rents by ZIP code and bedroom count. Returns FMR and SAFMR (Small Area FMR) monthly and annual figures with official HUD attribution.

tools.name: get_tax_deduction_checklist
tools.description: Return a Schedule E rental property tax deduction checklist — 25 deductions across 8 categories. Each entry includes IRS Schedule E line, deduction rule, and the most common landlord mistake.

params.name: category
params.description: Filter by category. Use 'all' for the full list. Default: all.

tools.name: calculate_rental_metrics
tools.description: Calculate NOI, cash-on-cash return, cap rate, DSCR, and equity percentage from gross rent, operating expenses, mortgage payment, purchase price, and down payment. Pure math — no external API call.

params.name: loan_balance
params.description: Current outstanding loan balance. Defaults to purchase_price minus down_payment.

params.name: current_value
params.description: Current estimated property value. Defaults to purchase_price.

params.name: mortgage_payment_monthly
params.description: Monthly mortgage payment (principal + interest only, not escrow).

params.name: operating_expenses_monthly
params.description: Monthly operating expenses EXCLUDING mortgage (tax, insurance, PM fee, repairs).

tools.name: get_brrr_checklist
tools.description: Return a phase-by-phase BRRR strategy checklist (Buy, Rehab, Rent, Refinance, Repeat). Each phase includes actionable tasks, benchmarks, and common investor mistakes.

params.name: phase
params.description: Which BRRR phase to show. Use 'all' for the complete checklist. Default: all.
